positions.title: Robot Networks Undergraduate Research
positions.description:
•	Evaluated the functionality of a decentralized multi-agent robotic network.
•	Developed software for operating ground robots using Python 3.0 and Raspberry Pi units.
•	Studied applications of Artificial Intelligence through use of the Kalman Filter Algorithm.

positions.title: Cellular Materials Undergraduate Research
positions.description:
•	Co-authored a Conference Proceeding published in the 2021 Solid Freeform Fabrication Symposium and the 2022 edition of JOM.
•	Using MATLAB, developed a program for evaluating failure criterion of cellular materials that is still used in continuing research.
•	Gathered experimental data through the use of 3-D printing techniques and stress testing.
•	Collaborated with a group of 6 students and presented research to the campus academic community.

organizations.name: IEEE - HKN Honor Society
organizations.description:
I joined HKN during the spring semester of my junior year. I had the opportunity to meet several talented engineers on the executive board. I feel confident each of these young leaders will have a major impact in any role they choose to pursue. 

During my year of membership, our executive team was able to induct more than 30 new members. We effectively doubled the size of the club and recovered to pre-pandemic attendance levels.
